title: Release
description: The body of the signed POST /v1/dispatches/<dispatch_id>/release, application/json: the adapter that serves the node pool gives the run back, why, and whether the run should wait for another claim. Before the handover, a release with retry: true returns the same run, with the same run_id, to the queue, as a lapsed lease does. After the handover, a release ends the run, since a dispatch whose handover is answered never goes back to the queue: the release is answered 200, not refused 409, and the gateway refuses the run's key with 410 when the job attaches. With retry: true it then queues a new run, with a new run_id and a new run key, since a run key is handed over at most once per run. A dispatch_id that is unknown, or that belongs to another adapter, is refused 403 forbidden, with the same signed body as an unknown pool, so nobody learns whether an id exists; the control plane decides this before any 409 or 410. The adapter's signature and that check authorise the request, not the id. After the dispatch ended because its work item was closed or undone, a release is refused, 410 gone. It is signed with the adapter's access key as https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/definitions.schema.json describes. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, or a request whose signature it has already seen, with an unsigned 401. A member this schema does not define is refused, invalid_request.

version.description: The document format. The control plane refuses a version it does not read.

time.description: When the adapter built the body, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401.

reason.description: Why the adapter gives the run back, display text, 1 to 200 characters.

retry.description: true when the run should wait for another claim: before the handover the same run waits again; after it, a new run, with a new run_id and a new run key. false when it should not.
